cpu_blas: Fedora OpenBLAS 0.3.29 OpenMP variant, one system OpenMP runtime

dispatch_cpu_profile.scope: Thread CPU time includes kernel work; wall minus CPU includes sleeping/descheduling and hardware wait. This does not measure ANE cycles or prove a clock cause.

mac_exact_input_output_comparison: unverified: regenerated Linux FP16 inputs differ from captured Mac hashes
limitations: Active desktop; clocks not pinned. The 23-second measurement has substantial variation. CPU decoder math/build differs from Mac. Dispatch is synchronous ioctl including polling and scheduling, not isolated hardware execution.

dispatch_affinity_profile.scope: Move only synchronous ioctl to efficiency CPU0 or performance CPU4; preparation/readback stay on performance cores. Two warmups and five calls per round, reversed order, bitwise outputs verified.

timing_units: milliseconds, except rtf which is dimensionless

hybrid_precision_diagnostics.scope: Diagnostic CPU substitutions, not the production ANE path. All variants retain FP32 host normalization, exact GELU and residual state. The passing control retains ANE convolutions and FFN first projections only.
hybrid_precision_diagnostics.limitation: The five-second passing control is narrowly below the gate. Host substitutions are much slower than the native path; this proves neither a corrected ANE graph nor macOS speed parity.

rtf_correction.reason: Historical parser divided every clip by 11 seconds; corrected to each actual clip duration. Stage/wall timings unchanged; raw historical receipts preserved.

dispatch_log_mask_probe.scope: Telemetry header masks only; task chain, registers, exception masks, coefficient data and input packing unchanged. Warm dispatch wall/CPU time, not isolated ANE cycles.
dispatch_log_mask_probe.conclusion: No parity with Mac execute 10.88 ms; active-desktop variation prevents assigning a reliable gain to these masks. Production command stream unchanged.

driver_stage_profile.scope: Synchronous ioctl wall/thread CPU times and instrumented kernel stages. wait_ns includes hardware wait plus polling/scheduling, not isolated ANE cycles.
driver_stage_profile.output_dtype: FP16; reference native FP32 dump converts losslessly to FP16
driver_stage_profile.core_load_scope: Only ioctl core placement and a separate integer CPU load change. Frequency samples are CPU policy values, not ANE clock measurements. Original task stream retained; output poisoned and checked bitwise each submission.
driver_stage_profile.interpretation: Enqueue and IRQ drain are too small to explain the Mac gap. Efficiency-core wait falls from 32.42 ms to 13.93 ms with an independent performance-core integer load, showing dependence on CPU/cluster activity. Does not measure ANE frequency or separate hardware execution from polling/scheduling.

polling_control.preparation: All three native mel/output pairs checked; checkpoint reconstructed to pinned payload hashes. Need new module loaded and poll_sleep_us writable to test intervals.

paired_projection_diagnostics.scope: Existing dense ANE projection tasks; FP32 activation high/low planes, host FP32 sums and unfused affine input. CPU FP32 attention, normalization, GELU and residuals retained. Separate diagnostic from the native 1779-task encoder. Production full-logit gate remains failed.

repeatability.scope: Encoder-only Python precision diagnostic, including CPU reference checks inside the runner. Two ANE activation planes per QKV projection; exactly zero weight planes omitted. CPU FP32 attention, normalization, nonlinearities, residuals and output projections remain. Not the native transcription benchmark.

paired_projection_diagnostics.interpretation: Paired Q/K/V, output and FFN-first projections pass all 80 fixed-history vectors with existing ANE tasks when combined with CPU FP32 normalization/attention/GELU/residuals. Four/eight input partitions alone still fail the five-second gate. Supported residual feedback paths returned zero correction. These diagnostics do not establish a corrected native full encoder or macOS speed parity.

two_input_partitions.scope: Failed five-second diagnostic; not a production optimization

all_projection_fc1_validation.scope: All encoder matrix projections run on ANE using paired activations; CPU FP32 normalization, attention, exact GELU and residuals remain. Not the native production encoder.
all_projection_fc1_validation.command_upload_note: One complete command upload initializes constants; subsequent submissions upload only their active prefixes. Byte preservation verified; no warm speed improvement established.

shared_source_refactor.metric_parity: All original timings retained; short/repeated Linux RTF corrected to actual clip duration
shared_source_refactor.native_output_preservation: All three CPU and ANE mel/encoder/logit files are byte identical to previous execution
shared_source_refactor.precision_diagnostic_preservation: PASS: all three feature arrays bitwise identical; all 80 token choices identical and numerical metrics agree within 1e-12
shared_source_refactor.checkpoint_reconstruction: PASS: all six pinned payload hashes
shared_source_refactor.scope: Source refactor verification; native production accuracy failure retained; macOS hardware not tested on Linux

matrix_stage_profile.scope: Shared per-matrix instrumentation; profiled diagnostic timings while the native full-logit gate remains failed. This is not a replacement for the unprofiled baseline.
matrix_stage_profile.weight_conversion: FP16 to FP32 rows via std::async; OpenBLAS GEMM uses the system OpenMP runtime.

cpu_sampling_profile.scope: ANE plus CPU JFK transcription, four performance-core workers; user CPU cycles only, not wall-time shares or ANE cycles.
cpu_sampling_profile.limitations: Some PAC-tagged parent addresses in DWARF callchains remain unresolved; leaf symbols resolve. Targeted hot loops use NEON FP16 widening and FP32 FMLA. Mac hot routines and AMX use remain unverified.

clang_sgemm_experiment.scope: Clang only for the hot ggml sgemm translation unit; no accuracy or performance claim.
